name: British Museum
desc: The entire ancient world, admission zero. Rosetta Stone before lunch, mummies after. Rain-proof too.

name: Borough Market
desc: A thousand years of market under the railway arches. Free samples if you make eye contact bravely.

name: Tate Modern
desc: World-class art in an old power station, free. The Thames view from the top floor is the encore.

name: Hyde Park
desc: Royal grass, rentable deck chairs, swans with attitude. Bring a sandwich, own the afternoon.

name: Tower Bridge
desc: Walking across the fancy blue one costs nothing and photographs like a movie set. Go at blue hour.

name: Camden Market
desc: Punk leftovers, canal-side food stalls, and stuff you didn't know you wanted. Browsing is free therapy.

name: Buckingham Palace
desc: Stand at the gates and judge the guards' hats for free. The King will not be checking your bank balance.

name: Primrose Hill
desc: One short climb, the whole skyline laid out like a postcard you didn't have to buy.

name: Tower of London
desc: A thousand years of drama, ravens on payroll, and the actual Crown Jewels. Someday-splurge material.

name: London Eye
desc: Thirty slow minutes above the Thames in a glass pod. Save it for someone worth the ticket.
